items.title: Approximating a relative map that is an isomorphism on completions by an etale morphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)

items.difficulty_reason: Building on the relative map approximation lemma, the statement assumes that the given local map of completions is an isomorphism and concludes that the approximating diagram can be chosen with the map f etale. The proof first replaces the thickening target by the controlling modification, shows that the completion map is an isomorphism for the etale neighbourhoods involved, and then invokes the lifting criterion to see that f is smooth at the point; the etale conclusion follows because the source map is already unramified. The reduction of the completion isomorphism to smoothness at the point is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 11727-11798.
